#define DLG_DLG_H
#include <stdarg.h>
struct dlg_origin { const char* file; const char* function; int line; const char* tag; };

EOF

rm -f config.mk builds/unix/unix-def.mk builds/unix/unix-cc.mk
./configure CFLAGS='-g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer' >/tmp/ft_config6.log 2>&1 && make -j$(nproc) >/tmp/ft_make6.log 2>&1 && gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address,undefined -Iinclude -I. /tmp/build_mini.c -o /workspace/mini_ft_013 objs/.libs/libfreetype.a -lz -lbz2 -lpng -lm && echo built || (echo CONFIG; tail -80 /tmp/ft_config6.log; echo MAKE; tail -120 /tmp/ft_make6.log; exit 1)
